amendment_1.fixed_frame: Object-hallucination metrics such as CHAIR and object F1 score captions against gold; registered tests examine whether gold completeness and object count change them.
amendment_1.brace_fill_format: Each brace is filled mechanically, with no other words: {S}, {R}, {R'} and {k} take the integer the evaluator prints; {C*} takes the control name the evaluator prints (matched_prefix, sentence_tie_average or uniform_random_subset); {passed | failed | not run}, {selected {C*} | no control passed | not run} and {; a run was invalid under the registered protocol check, with no valid re-run | ; its runs were not scored by the freeze} take exactly one listed alternative, verbatim; {G2B-O1 and G2B-E2 verdict per set} takes 'O1/E2: CV295 v/v, XM600 v/v, UV231 v/v'; {G2B-E1 verdict per set} takes 'E1: CV295 v, XM600 v, UV231 v'; {failing verdicts} takes 'c: CV295 v, XM600 v, UV231 v', where c lists each of O1, E2 and P1, in that order, that is FAIL on at least one set, joined by '/', and each v gives those claims' verdicts in the same order, joined by '/'; {; if K1 fired: its exponent is dataset-specific} takes '; its exponent is dataset-specific' if K1 fired and nothing otherwise; every v is the evaluator's verdict token (PASS, FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE or NOT_EVALUABLE).

amendment_2.note: Amendment 2 (PD-18): ADDS the A-N1 registered-secondary outcome sentences; no existing verdict rule, selection logic, precondition, qualifier or placeholder changed.
amendment_2.selection: A-N1 is the registered secondary test of condensed F1 on the G2-B outputs. The outcome is the one score_an1.py computes (score_an1.outcome, the A-N1 addendum's rule): SUPPORTED, MIXED, NOT_SUPPORTED or NOT_TESTABLE. The sentence for that outcome is used verbatim; it has no braces.
amendment_2.position: Right after the C2 sentence and its one-reference clause, in every outcome.

a_n1_sentences.NOT_SUPPORTED: In a registered secondary test (second backbone on development images), condensed F1 given verified negatives does not shrink the slope's gold-completeness dependence.
a_n1_sentences.NOT_TESTABLE: The registered secondary test (second backbone on development images) of condensed F1 given verified negatives was not evaluable.

rules: N1-XM-1: slope(refs1_randk) < 0
N1-XM-2: slope(refs_all) > 0
N1-XM-3: slope(oiv7_verified) > 0
N1-XM-4: slope(refs1_randk) < slope(refs_all) < slope(oiv7_verified)
N1-XM-5: for each gold variant g in {refs1_firstk, refs1_randk, refs_all, oiv7_verified}, sign(slope_g) = sign(M*_mixed(g) - median M)
Kill: If >= 2 of the 3 out-of-sample sign predictions (N1-XM-1, N1-XM-2, N1-XM-3) fail, N1 is demoted from a core result to an explanatory lemma / diagnostic.
Kill: If slope(refs1_randk) >= 0 (N1-XM-1 fails), N1's 1-reference prediction fails in a third setting and the sign-flip claim is dropped

computed.N1-XM-5_detail: N1-XM-5 agrees for 3 of 4 gold variants; it fails only for refs_all, where M*_mixed = 1.7631 is above the median M = 1.3833 but the slope is -2.4278 (prereg_comparisons[20].observed_value.per_gold.refs_all). Both failures therefore concern the gold of all 2-3 references.
computed.registered_verdict: N1-XM-1, N1-XM-3 and N1-XM-4 PASS; N1-XM-2 and N1-XM-5 FAIL; kill rules not fired (1 of the 3 out-of-sample sign predictions failed; N1-XM-1 passed). Predictions mixed, not a clean pass (§2).

G2B.scope: registered primary claims only (G2B-E1, G2B-E2, G2B-O1, G2B-P1); G2B-NS multi-reference sign NOT predicted
rules: sign_gt_0: PASS if ci95_lo > 0; FAIL if point <= 0; else INCONCLUSIVE
sign_lt_0: PASS if ci95_hi < 0; FAIL if point >= 0; else INCONCLUSIVE
compound: FAIL if any part is FAIL; else NOT_EVALUABLE if any part is NOT_EVALUABLE; else PASS if every part is PASS; else INCONCLUSIVE

G2B-E1 slope[refs1_randk](LADDER) sign_lt_0; G2B-E2 slope[complete](LADDER) sign_gt_0; G2B-O1 slope[refs_all]-slope[refs1_randk] sign_gt_0 and slope[complete]-slope[refs_all] sign_gt_0; G2B-P1 b[refs_all]-b[refs1_randk] sign_gt_0 and b[complete]-b[refs_all] sign_gt_0
K1: G2B-P1 is FAIL on 2 or more of the 3 datasets -> drops the completeness account for this backbone and reports only that the exponent is dataset-specific
KN1: G2B-E1 is FAIL on any dataset -> the sign-flip claim (N1) is dropped from Paper A; only the ordering result can remain
'Replicates on a second backbone' may be written only for CV295 and XM600, and only where G2B-E1, G2B-E2 and G2B-O1 all PASS.
Prediction: |dP_MCP| < 0.5
Kill: |dP_MCP| > 1.0, or a 95% interval that excludes 0, means the matched-prefix control is miscalibrated: stop, and draw no matched-prefix conclusion from E1 or N9
Admissible iff |dP| <= 0.5 and its 95% interval covers 0; C* = first admissible control in the order matched prefix, sentence tie-average, uniform random subset
K-F: If |dCHAIR_i| > 1.0 or |dCHAIR_s| > 1.5, the protocol is fixed before any method look. The failed run is kept and disclosed.
P1: A method SURVIVES iff its Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 AND dP_C* >= +1.0
K-headline: If at least half of the methods (>= 3 of 6) SURVIVE on P1, the headline becomes 'training changes object choice'.
K-rank: If no pair is significantly reversed, Paper A reports N9 as 'consistent with the raw ranking' and rests no claim on it.

K-placebo: If no control is admissible on K2, P1 has no primary control. N9 reports the three per-image controls as a specification curve and makes no 'survives count control' claim, and Paper A's C1 wording becomes 'count control changes the ranking'.
Prediction (b): HELD iff D_b >= +0.3 and its 95% lower bound > 0; K-b: If D_b < 0.1, prediction (b) is dropped and N9 'shows no dk -> dm link'
(i) OLS slope beta_M < 0 and 95% CI upper bound < 0
(ii) d tau_b = tau_b(z_P, Rel) - tau_b(P_raw, Rel) >= +0.10 and CI lower bound > 0
(iii) acc_ceq - acc_cdiff > 0 and CI lower bound > 0
Overall verdict: PASS if all three tests pass, FAIL if none passes, otherwise MIXED.

VaPR.carries: human validity (PD-10 grouping; preference data, not human judgments)
rules: Pass rule: the Wilson 95% lower bound of VaPR's count-matched share exceeds each comparator's share.
Verdict rule: PASS if the pass rule holds. PARTIAL_POINT_ONLY if only the point estimate exceeds all three. FAIL otherwise.
